items.title: Bullfrog brains can make their own backup fuel
items.summary: For decades, scientists believed most animals relied on a steady supply of glucose, the body's primary fuel source, to power their brains. When glucose runs out, neural activity begins to fail, potentially leading to lasting brain damage.

items.title: One of Canada's worst invasive species may have arrived naturally
